distractors: Deeply committed to a cause or a group, in the way that shows up in what you give up rather than in what you say.
Placed inside another team for a stretch so that you work to their rhythm and their priorities, while your reporting line stays exactly where it was.
Absorbed in a task to the exclusion of everything else, to the point where hours go by without your noticing them and whatever else was due that day quietly does not happen.

Held back by rules and procedure written for a situation that no longer exists, so that the sensible course takes six approvals and the unhelpful one takes none. The obstruction is in the process rather than in anybody's intent.

Aligned closely enough with somebody that the two plans never come into conflict, because each side checks with the other before it moves. The coordination is deliberate, it is reviewed on a schedule, and either of them could stop doing it next month at very little cost.
